summary: The retained formulations withstand three constructive checks against committed Beta concerns: internal incidence costs, multiplicity-preserving projections and explicit theorem parameters. Literal controls confirm why the restrictions matter. No new revision is required in this bounded scope; no compiler, solver or full replay was run.

checks.observation: The 16-member lifted family has no sunflower among 560 triples, complete pair-link edges 12,15,23,34,45, degree 16 at its centre and exactly one relevant internal member. Thus d-I=15, while an unconditional degree 15 bound fails. The internal certificate retains the subtraction. Stage two applies degree 15 only after the preceding internal-member contradiction. This validates the guarded formulation, not a size68 counterexample.

checks.scope: Multiplicity-preserving projection as the repair for binary proper traces
checks.method: Read D19-model-bridge.md Section 2 and degree19_projection_v5.py:68–100; independently rebuilt Beta’s two-completion control.
checks.observation: The 21-member family with complete root degree 19 is sunflower-free across 1330 triples and has two residual completions of trace 067. All 285 actual-anchor trace identities agree with a coordinate of weight 2. Adding a third completion creates a sunflower. The source assigns triple traces upper bound 2 and full traces upper bound 1; only full traces are binary. Its forbidden-trace option explicitly requires absence of every completion, so absence of one exterior representative cannot justify a zero coordinate.

checks.observation: H27 is a proposition quantified over actual finite four-uniform families; cardinality roots take h27 as an argument. The removed pool is a filter of actual residual members. Intersection is proved before h27 is applied, with uniformity and sunflower-freeness inherited through subset inclusion. The bound 37 additionally takes hpool bounding that actual pool by 10. Neither the axiom allow-list nor TwoAvoidance supplies these hypotheses. Arbitrary ground types remain permitted, without a support cutoff.
